anatomy: Cephalopod-like head with four primary tentacles around a central mouth; large, moist, dark eyes; a smaller, glowing blue squid-like parasite or symbiont sits atop the skull
coloration: Mottled purple and teal skin with pinkish bioluminescent spots; the dorsal symbiont glows with a bright, ethereal cyan light
attire_and_adornment: High-collared armor composed of overlapping translucent crystals; silver metallic bracers with integrated hologram displays on each wrist
posture_and_expression: Forward-facing, neutral stance; the large eyes convey a sense of ancient intelligence and curiosity; tentacles are relaxed
distinctive_traits: The crystalline armor appears to be grown rather than manufactured, with geometric facets that refract the ambient light of the bridge
